item.title: North America offers export boost for British dairy and red meat producers
item.description: AHDB has highlighted future opportunities for exports of high-quality British dairy and red meat to North America. Dairy exports could be the biggest beneficiary, with cheese consumption across the continent forecast to rise by an average of 11% by 2034.
